footing_check: BROKE since Tier 1.5. The Q1-2026 print (qtr ended Mar 31, reported ~May 2026, after the T1.5 verify) contradicts the move's load-bearing fact: T1.5 framed a "dx-partner rev +81% YoY revenue ramp," but the Q1 call has the CFO guiding FY2026 diagnostics partner revenue FLAT at ~$10M (=FY25 level) with NO direct testing revenue in 2026 — the AD-Dx ramp the Tier-2 pin-down exists to quantify has been explicitly deferred past 2026. Stock also already ~55-60% off highs ($3.50-3.87 vs $8.77 52wk high; cap ~$165-180M). FDA date itself holds (H2-26, no slip) and cash is intact (~$103M, no debt), but the revenue-inflection footing failed.
drop_reason: no-path + thin-setup — J1 fails both kinds: the binary was mis-specified (FDA clearance is NOT first-in-class — Fujirebio's p-tau217 test is already FDA-cleared/live via Quest — and NOT the value-unlock); the dx leg is ~8% of revenue, guided FLAT for 2026, sitting atop an organically declining core (Simoa -21%, Akoya -26%, pharma -33%); all four discriminators are asserted, none shown; CMS currently sidelines blood-based tests from coverage. No credible >=4x and no protected 3-4x; weak asymmetry. Survives (not ruin) but does not earn a scarce Tier-3 slot.
theme: Blood-Based Alzheimer's Diagnostics (single-name binary; Tier-0 HOLD'd the broader theme). Reframed at Tier 2: QTRX is really a declining life-science-tools company (Simoa + acquired Akoya spatial) with a small, now-flat AD-Dx option — not a clean pure-play Dx binary.
best_vehicle: QTRX is the named asset (no on-list proxy); large-Dx names (DXCM, Quest/DGX as Fujirebio's channel) are scale benchmarks only. As a vehicle for the blood-Dx theme it is now a WEAK expression — late to FDA behind a cleared incumbent, dx revenue guided flat, core in decline.

three_judgments.path: Attempted mechanism: if 510(k) clears H2-26 -> LucentAD Complete converts Tempus/Life Line channels + CMS $897 -> dx revenue inflects -> re-rate ~$170M cap to >=4x (~$680M+). Tested vs the 4 discriminators it ASSERTS all, SHOWS none: (1) backlog converting -> NO, dx partner rev FLAT ~$10M FY25->FY26 guide, no acceleration; (2) on-date milestone -> FDA decision pending/announced-only AND no longer first-in-class (Fujirebio p-tau217 FDA-cleared May-2025, live via Quest), so clearance is not the value-unlock; (3) firm cash anchor -> Tempus/Life Line are distribution integrations, no firm fixed-price cash PO; (4) margin/CF inflection -> the co-wide CF-breakeven (Q4-26) is Akoya cost-out on a DECLINING base (Simoa -21%, Akoya -26%, pharma -33%), not a demand inflection; dx leg shows no bridge. CMS also currently sidelines blood-based tests from coverage. No credible >=4x (multibagger fails); no high-confidence, downside-protected 3-4x either (the only near catalyst is a non-unlocking binary into a crowded category) (great-trade fails). NEITHER -> automatic DROP.
three_judgments.asymmetry: Bull ~2-3x and LOW-prob/far-dated (clearance + eventual CMS coverage reversal + multi-year channel conversion against Fujirebio/Quest, Lilly, Roche/C2N, Beckman). Base ~flat-to-down: a double-digit-declining tools co grinding to breakeven, ~3x EV/S on shrinking ~$170M revenue (not obviously cheap). Bear ~-40 to -60%: organic erosion continues, clearance lands into a saturated category, cash drifts toward the ~$100M floor. Prob-weighted upside does NOT clearly dominate -> weak asymmetry (~U/D <=1.5x, marginal).
three_judgments.survival: Survives — ~$102.6M cash + marketable securities, NO debt, Q1 burn ~$14.7M adj (Q1 inflated by ~$11M annual payments; subsequent qtrs guided meaningfully lower), targeting CF-breakeven Q4-2026 with ~$100M year-end cash. No going-concern/debt-wall/dilution death-spiral; pre-profit is not impairment. Survival is the ONE prong that passes — but J1 and J2 already DROP.

strongest_bear: QTRX is a declining life-science-tools company (Simoa franchise -21% organic, acquired Akoya spatial -26% YoY, pharma -33% YoY) whose entire bull case rests on a ~8%-of-revenue Alzheimer's-Dx option that management just guided FLAT (~$10M) for 2026 with zero direct testing revenue — entering a category where the FDA-cleared first mover (Fujirebio/Quest) and pharma giants (Lilly, Roche/C2N, Beckman) are already ahead, and where CMS has explicitly sidelined blood tests from coverage. The "binary" was mis-framed: clearance is neither first-in-class nor value-unlocking, and the revenue ramp the thesis needs has been deferred past 2026. The headline "23% FY26 growth" is largely an Akoya acquisition-comp optic over an organically shrinking core.
gate_lineage_line: T2 DROP (provisional type: none) · PATH: mechanism asserts all 4 discriminators, shows none — dx rev guided FLAT ~$10M FY26 (no conversion), FDA clearance no longer first-in-class (Fujirebio p-tau217 cleared May-25) nor value-unlocking, no firm cash anchor, CF-breakeven is cost-out on a declining core; no credible >=4x and no protected 3-4x → automatic DROP · ASYMMETRY: bull ~2-3x low-prob/far-dated vs base flat-to-down vs bear -40/-60%, weak · SURVIVAL: clears (~$103M cash, no debt, breakeven Q4-26; not ruin) · STRONGEST BEAR: declining tools co (Simoa -21%/Akoya -26%/pharma -33%) whose ~8%-of-rev AD-Dx option is guided flat into a category with FDA-cleared incumbents (Fujirebio/Quest) + giants (Lilly/Roche), CMS coverage sidelined; binary mis-specified.
